checklist.title: Position joint case and mark cable reference points
checklist.look_for: The joint case (black plastic shell) is laid against or under the cable to set the joint position, and reference points are marked on the cable sheath (pen, tape or measured with a rule).
checklist.summary: Jointer positioned black joint case against cable and marked reference points on sheath with white tape.
checklist.reason: Joint case laid against cable, white tape applied at [t=7.0s] and [t=12.0s] showing marked reference points.

checklist.title: Remove outer cable sheath
checklist.look_for: Wearing insulating gloves, the jointer scores and strips the outer PVC sheath with an insulated knife between the marks, exposing the copper screen wires underneath.
checklist.summary: Jointer scored and stripped black PVC sheath with insulated knife, exposing copper screen wires.
checklist.reason: Frames show gloved hands using insulated knife to cut and peel back sheath [t=36.0s].

checklist.title: Separate and fold back copper screen wires
checklist.look_for: The thin copper screen (neutral/earth) wires are lifted off the inner bedding, separated and folded back along the cable away from the phase cores.
checklist.summary: Jointer separated and folded back copper screen wires from red, yellow, blue phase cores.
checklist.reason: Copper screen wires visibly lifted and folded back at [t=78.0s].

checklist.title: Expose phase conductors
checklist.look_for: The inner bedding/fillers are removed so the individual coloured phase cores (red, yellow, blue) are separated and clearly visible.
checklist.summary: Jointer stripped inner bedding to expose red, yellow, and blue phase cores using insulated knife.
checklist.reason: Frames show inner bedding removed, revealing separated red, yellow, and blue cores [t=99.0s].

checklist.title: Position and prepare phase conductors for jointing
checklist.look_for: The phase cores are spread and set at the connector positions, one phase at a time, with the other cores kept apart and protected.
checklist.summary: Jointer spread and set red, yellow, blue phase cores at connector positions.
checklist.reason: Frames show phase cores separated and positioned at connector slots, t=116.0s clearest.

checklist.title: Bundle and insulate copper screen wires
checklist.look_for: The folded-back copper screen wires are gathered into a bundle and wrapped or covered with insulating tape/screening material so no bare wire is exposed.
checklist.summary: Jointer bundled and insulated copper screen wires with insulating tape.
checklist.reason: Hands wrapping tape around bundled copper screen at [t=150.0s].

checklist.title: Prepare blue phase conductor and joint connector
checklist.look_for: Working on the blue phase only, the jointer cuts and strips the blue core to length and fits it into the joint (phase) connector, tightening the connector.
checklist.summary: Jointer cut, stripped, and tightened blue phase core into joint connector using insulated tool.
checklist.reason: Blue core inserted into orange connector, tightened at [t=309.0s] with visible tool action.

checklist.title: Perform potential difference check
checklist.ref: AWP-4/1 Part B · AWP-4/2 Step 4 · SI-18.2.16
checklist.look_for: An approved voltage tester / test lamp is applied to the conductors at the connector area (not the crutch) to check the potential difference before connection.
checklist.summary: Jointer applied approved tester to blue phase core at connector before connection.
checklist.reason: Hand in glove holds tester probe on blue core at connector, t=343.0s.

checklist.title: Complete and insulate the cable joint
checklist.look_for: The connections are completed and insulated (insulating shroud or tape over each connector), the screen wires are reinstated and the joint is closed up.
checklist.summary: Jointer insulated blue phase core connector with tape, then secured joint with tool.
checklist.reason: Blue core connector covered with tape at t=386.0s, tool used to secure joint at t=407.0s.
